menu.tpatools.about.main:
Thanx for using TPATools.
 This mod is developed by kicobicn.
 As a creator, I would like to express my gratitude to all the players who have supported and used TPATools.
 If you like this mod, I hope you can recommend it to others. If possible, you can leave your valuable suggestions/feedback on the mcmod wiki page of this mod
If you encounter any bug that causes a crash, you can also provide feedback on the issue page of GitHub, and I will check it periodically.
Of course, thanks to @Eirin (mcmod) for his/her suggestion[rtp,AllowTeleportRideEntity]
